The description is mostly complete, and the unchecked items are non-critical for a small datastore fix.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Objective [`#57916`]: when no title exists for the installer's bundle identifier, the installer must not attach to a same-name title that has a different bundle identifier. The diff at head changes `softwareInstallerTitleSelect` in `server/datastore/mysql/software_installers.go`. The name fallback now adds `AND bundle_identifier IS NULL`. A title with a non-NULL bundle identifier, such as `com.apple.finder.Open-Recents`, no longer matches by name. The query returns no match, so a new title is generated for `com.lapier.Recents`. Existing behavior is kept: a bundle-less title with the same name is still adopted, which is the case covered by `#55539`. The added test case in `testGetOrGenerateSoftwareInstallerTitleID` checks that a same-name payload with a different bundle identifier gets a distinct title ID, and that the new title stores the payload's bundle identifier. The test depends on a title created earlier in the same test function. This was not re-run during this assessment. The PR description reports that the test fails on main and passes with the change. No coding requirement from `#57916` is unmet.
